test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six people, F, G, H, I, J and K, got different marks in their examination. G got more marks than F and K. F got more marks than I, but not the highest marks. G scored more marks than H. K got more marks than J, but fewer marks than H. I got the thirdlowest marks. F got more marks than K but less than H. F got 59 marks and K got 46 marks. Who among the following got the highest marks?
solution:
Given: Six people, F, G, H, I, J and K. 

1)I got the third lowest marks. 

__ > __ > __ > I > __ > __

G got more marks than F and K. 

F got more marks than I, but not the highest marks. 

F got more marks than K but less than H.

G scored more marks than H. 

G > H > F > I > K > __

K got more marks than J, but fewer marks than H. 

G > H > F > I > K > J

F got 59 marks and K got 46 marks. 

G > H > F(59) > I > K(46) > J

Here, G got the highest marks.

Hence, the correct answer is **"G"**.
